controls.label: Weight noise
controls.disabledReason: Perturb the adapter weights with small seeded noise after every optimizer step (relative to each tensor's RMS) — a regularizer against overfitting a small character dataset. Off by default.

controls.label: Gradient noise
controls.disabledReason: Seeded Gaussian adapter-gradient noise: eta / (1 + step)^gamma. Helps escape poor early minima. Off by default.

controls.label: Multi-resolution buckets
controls.disabledReason: Train every image at several resolutions with square rows, or explicitly choose width × height rows to assign images by closest aspect. Each row has its own repeat count per epoch. Replaces the single Resolution above. Off by default.

controls.label: Depth anchoring
controls.disabledReason: Keep the character's 3D shape consistent: the model's prediction is decoded and a frozen depth model compares its depth to the training image's. Needs the TAEW2.1 tiny decoder and a Depth Anything V2 model installed. Off by default.

controls.label: Body proportion loss
controls.disabledReason: Body proportion loss: the model's prediction is decoded and compared to the training image by a frozen body model; images with no person are skipped. Needs the TAEW2.1 tiny decoder and ViTPose+ Base installed. Off by default.

controls.label: Body shape loss
controls.disabledReason: Body shape loss: the model's prediction is decoded and compared to the training image by a frozen body model; images with no person are skipped. Needs the TAEW2.1 tiny decoder, ViTPose+ Base and HybrIK ResNet-34 installed. Off by default.

controls.label: Surface normals loss
controls.disabledReason: Surface normals loss: the model's prediction is decoded and compared to the training image by a frozen body model; images with no person are skipped. Needs the TAEW2.1 tiny decoder, ViTPose+ Base and Sapiens Normal 0.3B installed. Off by default.

controls.label: Identity loss
controls.disabledReason: Keep the character's face: the model's prediction is decoded and a frozen face recognizer (ArcFace) compares the face to the training images'. Images without a detectable face are skipped. Needs the TAEW2.1 tiny decoder and the InstantID face analysis stack installed. Off by default.

controls.label: Face landmark loss
controls.disabledReason: Keep the character's face shape: a frozen face-mesh model compares the predicted face's landmarks (jaw, lips, eyes, nose) to the training image's. Needs the TAEW2.1 tiny decoder, the InstantID face analysis stack and MediaPipe FaceMesh v2 installed. Off by default.

controls.label: VAE anchor loss
controls.disabledReason: Match the training image at several scales: the model's prediction is decoded and a frozen FLUX.2 VAE encoder compares its features with the training image's. Needs the TAEW2.1 tiny decoder and the FLUX.2 VAE installed. Off by default.

controls.label: Subject-masked loss
controls.disabledReason: Subject-focused loss uses a mask on every image; missing masks are generated with SAM3 at training start. On in Z-Image character presets, otherwise off.
